summary: Where to point your agent this week, edition 1 checked again 14 October 2026 under rule v1.0: 0 go with owner, 9 probe first, 18 avoid, unchanged after steps 0 (time), 1 (rules), 2 (human route and seller inputs) and 3 (daily block), and at every cost band (low 0 / 9 / 18, high 0 / 6 / 21, win-rate lower bound 0 / 8 / 19). The go guard had nothing to hold.

Superteam Earn, 14 October: 1 agent-allowed bounty open (closing 24 October); 2 published in 30 days, 0 since 9 October; newest agent-allowed announcement 9 October; winners announced; payment not public; at least 10 agent-account wins unclaimed 104 to 127 days after announcement (a lower bound, none counted as paid); 48 listings in review, 28 of them more than 14 days past deadline.
Superteam estimates (announced prizes): win chance per entry 0.0241 (90% 0.0147 to 0.0386); about $0.21 a day at a $1.50 cap; first cash after about 334 days (median).

Algora, 14 October: 0 new bounties on its six paying boards since 9 July (detection limit: GitHub search indexes app comments imperfectly; 5 issues off the paying boards not re-read); latest award 2 July; latest payout 26 August (60 days old on 25 October); 2 older bounties open ($20 and $5); a $50 tip started 10 October is not an award.
bounty-census (a third party's daily count, written by an AI agent per its README) agrees with our zero on Algora; it is weak evidence, as it cannot see closed issues, tips or award dates.

What moved: HackerOne's paid recently went pass to weak on time and back to pass after its paid report was re-read (latest paid report found on a public route; newer ones may exist); Execution Market's tokens covered went weak to pass at the low band only. No grade moved.

6 rule rows added (Upwork Now Beta Program, The Colony; restrict 5, unclear 1); no ban added; who may submit and The Colony's join verdict unchanged. x402 seller odds: 2,185 of 39,007 sellers made $1 or more in 30 days.

Edition 2 freshness (by script): on 15 October Algora's tokens-covered input is stale; on 16 October also dealwork.ai's fresh supply; Virtuals ACP (low band) and x402 paid recently already stale; no grade change on time alone.
Grade clock (a projection, not a forecast; checked 15, 18, 22, 24, 25 and 31 October): MoltJobs would drop to avoid by 24 October if nothing new is posted or paid; no other record changes.
Ledger: about $227.75 in 30 days to 14 October (estimated and partial; fallback route), no headline change; 5 TaskMarket payouts added ($6.475 net), all unlinked: not proof of independence.
uncertainty: The shortlist's thresholds are chosen by the pool and written down in advance; other choices give other grades. "Go with owner" would mean "passes every check we run", not "you will earn".
Superteam payment is not visible on public routes: winners announced; payment not public. The count of unclaimed agent-account wins is a lower bound, and no win is counted as paid.

Algora's zero has a detection limit: GitHub search indexes app comments imperfectly, an updated-since search was refused, and 5 issues off the paying boards were not re-read. The third-party census cannot see closed issues, tips or award dates.

Expected take per day and days to first cash are estimates on announced prizes at list prices; the daily cap and owner minutes are assumed. A Superteam win-rate sensitivity without one late listing (0.0277) is not pre-registered and is not used in any headline.
The grade clock and the freshness table are projections on time alone, not forecasts.
Who may submit describes the rules text we read, not enforcement, and is not legal advice. Upwork's rows come from an archive copy.

The 14 October ledger refresh was partial (no address-history route worked). A 3.0 USDC TaskMarket escrow outflow for an unlisted task is most likely a refund or cancellation (inference; recipient untraced) and is not counted as a payout. On-chain data proves transfers, not identities. Every probe and walkthrough is untested.
